content: Benadryl is a brand name utilized by Johnson & Johnson (since its acquisition in the fall of 2006) and Pfizer for various allergy medications. In the United States, Benadryl refers to diphenhydramine, which is classified as a first-generation antihistamine. This formulation is also available in combination with other active ingredients and marketed under different variations of the Benadryl name. In the United Kingdom, Benadryl Allergy Relief contains acrivastine, a second-generation antihistamine. Additionally, in the United Kingdom, Benadryl Once a Day contains cetirizine, another second-generation antihistamine.
